subject: Observability add-ons — savings worksheet + legal/ops questions
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara@auroralabs.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: observability add-ons scope and numbers

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the team liked the advanced dashboards and the low-latency traces. Before we move to procurement, Evan asked for a simple line-item view that shows: 1) retention tiers (30/90/365 days) pricing; 2) tracing ingest credits vs. cost per million spans; and 3) advanced dashboard seats vs. a seatless workspace fee.

Two asks from procurement:
- Can you show a blended savings scenario if we commit to 12 months with a 20% add-on discount?
- Legal wants any SLA or retention guarantees called out (retention restore windows, account-level exports).

Can you send a worksheet and a draft SOW we can review? We'd like to close before the end of Q3 if numbers look good.

Best,
Lara
Director of Platform Ops
Aurora Labs

Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-01T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: observability add-ons scope and numbers

Lara — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a savings_worksheet_v2.xlsx that lays out per-month and annualized costs across the 3 retention tiers, tracing ingest bands, and two procurement models: seat-based dashboards and a seatless workspace fee.

Notes on structure:
- Retention pricing is expressed as $/GB-month for stored trace indexes + a small per-query fee for >30d lookbacks.
- Tracing ingest: we modeled 0–10M, 10–50M, and 50M+ spans with step discounts.
- Advanced dashboards: we included a seat price and an alternative seatless tier that charges by workspace with a cap.

On discounts: the worksheet shows a 20% discount applied to add-ons when combined with a 12-month hosted commitment (hosted inference + observability add-ons). The blended savings line is highlighted. If procurement wants different effective discounting (e.g., piecewise across tiers), we can re-run quickly.

Kimberly — looping you in for the SOW and any retention SLA language. Priyom — can you review the worksheet math and confirm whether we can offer the seatless cap at $X/month for Aurora at that commit level?

Next steps: Markus to send worksheet + redlined SOW; internal check on legal/ops constraints; follow-up call with procurement on Friday if that works for you, Lara.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: savings_worksheet_v2.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-02T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: observability add-ons scope and numbers

Markus / Priyom — quick legal review and redline highlights attached (SOW_Aurora_v1_redline.pdf). High-level points:
- Retention guarantees: we can commit to retention durability, and provide export tooling for account-level backups. We cannot promise restore windows under 24 hours for data older than 180 days without the archival add-on.
- Data residency: Aurora is US-only; standard clause applies. If they require specific region pinning in a private deployment, that's a separate procurement line.
- Audit logs & access: include a clause for audit log retention 1 year; can extend to 3 years with an add-on.

Commercial ask: if we include a 20% add-on discount with a 12-month hosted commitment, legal wants an explicit termination-pro rata on add-on credits and an early-exit reconciliation.

I flagged the SLA language and a couple of clauses around export tooling. Once Priyom confirms the commercial math and the seatless cap, I can convert the redline to a final SOW for signature.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_Aurora_v1_redline.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Lara Chen <lara@auroralabs.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-03T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: observability add-ons scope and numbers

Lara / team — I ran the worksheet numbers with finance. Summary and proposed commercial: 

- Offer: 12-month hosted commitment including core inference + observability add-ons.
- Add-on discount: 20% on observability list prices (applies across retention tiers and tracing ingest banded pricing).
- Seatless workspace option: capped at $3,500/month for up to 15 workspaces, after which a per-workspace overage of $200 applies.
- Tracing ingest: first 10M spans/month included at the discounted rate; stepped pricing beyond with 10% additional volume discount at 50M+.
- SLA/Retention: we will accept the legal redline on retention durability + account export tooling; restore window note as Kimberly suggested (24h for >180d archival).

I've uploaded the final worksheet and a cleaned SOW to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/aurora/sow/12345. Lara — if that matches your procurement expectations we can send to Evan for signature and schedule kickoff. If Aurora wants an alternate split of the 20% (e.g., 10% on retention, 30% on dashboards), we can model that but it will require a revised internal approval.

Next: procurement review -> signature -> onboarding kickoff (target start: 2025-08-11).

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: savings_worksheet_v2.xlsx (final), SOW_Aurora_v1_clean.pdf (uploaded to DocuSign)
